{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01D4FaYtpM5j1kyiWncaiR2m","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"HTML rendering.\n\nResponsibility: turn the parsed tree into HTML, escape HTML text and attributes, and\npercent-encode URLs. The conformance runner compares normalized HTML, so tag structure and\nentities must match the spec examples.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport string\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import Block\n\nInlineParser = Callable[[str], str]\n\nESCAPES = ((\"&\", \"&amp;\"), (\"<\", \"&lt;\"), (\">\", \"&gt;\"), ('\"', \"&quot;\"))\nURL_SAFE_CHARS = frozenset(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + \";,/?:@&=+$-_.!~*'()#\")\nHEX_DIGITS = frozenset(string.hexdigits)\n\n\ndef escape_html(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Escape &, <, > and \" so the text renders as literal characters. The ampersand goes first.\"\"\"\n    for raw, entity in ESCAPES:\n        text = text.replace(raw, entity)\n    return text\n\n\ndef percent_encode_url(url: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Percent-encode a URL for use in an attribute.\n\n    URL-safe ASCII and existing %XX escapes are kept. Every other character is encoded as its\n    UTF-8 bytes, so a lone % becomes %25.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(url):\n        char = url[index]\n        if char == \"%\" and _is_hex_pair(url[index + 1 : index + 3]):\n            out.append(url[index : index + 3])\n            index += 3\n            continue\n        if char in URL_SAFE_CHARS:\n            out.append(char)\n        else:\n            out.extend(f\"%{byte:02X}\" for byte in char.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _is_hex_pair(text: str) -> bool:\n    return len(text) == 2 and all(char in HEX_DIGITS for char in text)\n\n\ndef render_document(root: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Phase 2 walk: render the top-level blocks in order, one line ending after each block.\n\n    `parse_inline` is the inline parser hook. It receives the raw content of each paragraph and\n    returns that content's HTML.\n    \"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(_render_block(child, parse_inline) for child in root.children)\n\n\ndef _render_block(block: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    if block.kind.name == \"paragraph\":\n        return f\"<p>{parse_inline(block.content)}</p>\\n\"\n    raise ValueError(f\"no HTML renderer for block type {block.kind.name!r}\")\n----\n\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    Until the inline stories land, the content is only escaped.\n    \"\"\"\n    return escape_html(raw)\n\"\"\"Character references and backslash escapes.\n\nResponsibility: decode named entities (from the standard library table `html.entities.html5`,\nnames ending in a semicolon only) and numeric character references, and provide the backslash\nunescape helper.\n\"\"\"\n\"\"\"Link reference definitions: extraction, the document-wide reference map, and `normalize_label`.\n\nResponsibility: extract link reference definitions when a paragraph closes, store them in one\nreference map, and normalize labels with `str.casefold` plus whitespace collapse.\n\"\"\"\n----\n\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the mdparser test suite.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nPROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef project_root() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Absolute path to the application root, where `commonmark` and `pyproject.toml` live.\"\"\"\n    return PROJECT_ROOT\n----\n\"\"\"Renderer and inline hook tests: HTML escaping, URL percent-encoding, the phase 2 walk, and\nthe inline parser hook. Each test compares a returned string with its exact expected value.\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import blocks, inlines, render\nfrom mdparser.blocks import DOCUMENT, PARAGRAPH, Block, BlockRegistry, BlockType\n\n\ndef upper_hook(raw: str) -> str:\n    return raw.upper()\n\n\ndef render_source(lines: list[str], hook=inlines.parse_inline) -> str:\n    return render.render_document(blocks.parse_lines(lines), hook)\n\n\n# --- HTML escaping ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"text\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"&\", \"&amp;\"),\n        (\"<\", \"&lt;\"),\n        (\">\", \"&gt;\"),\n        ('\"', \"&quot;\"),\n        (\"'\", \"'\"),\n        (\"plain\", \"plain\"),\n        (\"\", \"\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_escape_html_maps_each_special_character(text: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert render.escape_html(text) == expected\n\n\ndef test_escape_html_does_not_escape_an_ampersand_twice() -> None:\n    assert render.escape_html(\"<&>\") == \"&lt;&amp;&gt;\"\n\n\n----\n#!/bin/bash\n# CommandCenter Operation\n# Name: Run Test Suite\n# Type: batch\n\n# --- Standard Preamble ---\nset -euo pipefail\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" && pwd)\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/data/logs\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')\nSCRIPT_NAME=$(basename \"$0\" .sh)\nLOG_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.log\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Arguments: $*\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Working dir: $PROJECT_DIR\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"---\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\ncd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n\n# --- Test Command (pyproject.toml foundation contract: pytest -q, run inside .venv) ---\nif [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then\n    echo \"error: .venv missing; run 'uv venv .venv && uv sync' first\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \"$@\" 2>&1 | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME finished at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"82c5b41f-ae04-40b4-a1b7-cc94cbdc7cb9","uuid":"61daa6c3-9924-4b99-be61-74dd5b16b1a8","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:02:26.431Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"\"\"\"HTML rendering.\n\nResponsibility: turn the parsed tree into HTML, escape HTML text and attributes, and\npercent-encode URLs. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01TRFS4iH433Nk8j6UKafDRw","type":"tool_result","content":"5887:## Code spans\n8781:## Autolinks\n8968:## Raw HTML\n## Autolinks\n\n[Autolink](@)s are absolute URIs and email addresses inside\n`<` and `>`. They are parsed as links, with the URL or email address\nas the link label.\n\nA [URI autolink](@) consists of `<`, followed by an\n[absolute URI] followed by `>`.  It is parsed as\na link to the URI, with the URI as the link's label.\n\nAn [absolute URI](@),\nfor these purposes, consists of a [scheme] followed by a colon (`:`)\nfollowed by zero or more characters other than [ASCII control\ncharacters][ASCII control character], [space], `<`, and `>`.\nIf the URI includes these characters, they must be percent-encoded\n(e.g. `%20` for a space).\n\nFor purposes of this spec, a [scheme](@) is any sequence\nof 2--32 characters beginning with an ASCII letter and followed\nby any combination of ASCII letters, digits, or the symbols plus\n(\"+\"), period (\".\"), or hyphen (\"-\").\n\nHere are some valid autolinks:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<http://foo.bar.baz>\n.\n<p><a href=\"http://foo.bar.baz\">http://foo.bar.baz</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<https://foo.bar.baz/test?q=hello&id=22&boolean>\n.\n<p><a href=\"https://foo.bar.baz/test?q=hello&amp;id=22&amp;boolean\">https://foo.bar.baz/test?q=hello&amp;id=22&amp;boolean</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<irc://foo.bar:2233/baz>\n.\n<p><a href=\"irc://foo.bar:2233/baz\">irc://foo.bar:2233/baz</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\nUppercase is also fine:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ>\n.\n<p><a href=\"MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ\">MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\nNote that many strings that count as [absolute URIs] for\npurposes of this spec are not valid URIs, because their\nschemes are not registered or because of other problems\nwith their syntax:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<a+b+c:d>\n.\n<p><a href=\"a+b+c:d\">a+b+c:d</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<made-up-scheme://foo,bar>\n.\n<p><a href=\"made-up-scheme://foo,bar\">made-up-scheme://foo,bar</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<https://../>\n.\n<p><a href=\"https://../\">https://../</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<localhost:5001/foo>\n.\n<p><a href=\"localhost:5001/foo\">localhost:5001/foo</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\nSpaces are not allowed in autolinks:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<https://foo.bar/baz bim>\n.\n<p>&lt;https://foo.bar/baz bim&gt;</p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\nBackslash-escapes do not work inside autolinks:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<https://example.com/\\[\\>\n.\n<p><a href=\"https://example.com/%5C%5B%5C\">https://example.com/\\[\\</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\nAn [email autolink](@)\nconsists of `<`, followed by an [email address],\nfollowed by `>`.  The link's label is the email address,\nand the URL is `mailto:` followed by the email address.\n\nAn [email address](@),\nfor these purposes, is anything that matches\nthe [non-normative regex from the HTML5\nspec](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#e-mail-state-(type=email)):\n\n    /^[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\n    (?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*$/\n\nExamples of email autolinks:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<foo@bar.example.com>\n.\n<p><a href=\"mailto:foo@bar.example.com\">foo@bar.example.com</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com>\n.\n<p><a href=\"mailto:foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com\">foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com</a></p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\nBackslash-escapes do not work inside email autolinks:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<foo\\+@bar.example.com>\n.\n<p>&lt;foo+@bar.example.com&gt;</p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\nThese are not autolinks:\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<>\n.\n<p>&lt;&gt;</p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n< https://foo.bar >\n.\n<p>&lt; https://foo.bar &gt;</p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<m:abc>\n.\n<p>&lt;m:abc&gt;</p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\n<foo.bar.baz>\n.\n<p>&lt;foo.bar.baz&gt;</p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\nhttps://example.com\n.\n<p>https://example.com</p>\n````````````````````````````````\n\n\n```````````````````````````````` example\nfoo@bar.example.com\n.\n<p>foo@bar.example.com</p>\n````````````````````````````````","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"82c5b41f-ae04-40b4-a1b7-cc94cbdc7cb9","uuid":"737cec64-8a5d-4136-869c-06286b3aef3b","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:02:27.622Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"5887:## Code spans\n8781:## Autolinks\n8968:## Raw HTML\n## Autolinks\n\n[Autolink](@)s are absolute URIs and email addresses inside\n`<` and `>`. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01R5a1ApLN7zeEHSec7qzVnN","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n2\t\n3\tResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\n4\tdelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\n5\tfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n6\t\"\"\"\n7\t\n8\tfrom mdparser.render import escape_html\n9\t\n10\t\n11\tdef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n12\t    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n13\t\n14\t    Until the inline stories land, the content is only escaped.\n15\t    \"\"\"\n16\t    return escape_html(raw)\n17\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"82c5b41f-ae04-40b4-a1b7-cc94cbdc7cb9","uuid":"af113c39-0374-48aa-b7a7-93385000da0b","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:03:12.841Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py","content":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    Until the inline stories land, the content is only escaped.\n    \"\"\"\n    return escape_html(raw)\n","numLines":17,"startLine":1,"totalLines":17}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01R5a1ApLN7zeEHSec7qzVnN","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1d6UKEs6j8xqsWMWkVt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Kdg159af7M9eV2tJeKDwNp","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py","content":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a backslash inside\n    it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not\n    open an autolink. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link whose href is percent-encoded and HTML-escaped, and whose label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3660,"cache_read_input_tokens":47021,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3660},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"82c5b41f-ae04-40b4-a1b7-cc94cbdc7cb9","uuid":"6242d08f-7697-46d5-ac7f-9b6c2dfb0910","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:03:17.610Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1d6U2sJ1BStNG9Nzk7E","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01Kdg159af7M9eV2tJeKDwNp":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py","content":"\"\"\"Phase The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link whose href is percent-encoded and HTML-escaped, and whose label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n"}}}

The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a backslash inside\n    it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not\n    open an autolink. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link whose href is percent-encoded and HTML-escaped, and whose label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":12,"newStart":5,"newLines":67,"lines":[" from `mdparser.refs`."," \"\"\""," ","-from mdparser.render import escape_html","+import re","+import string"," ","+from mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url"," ","+ASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)","+","+# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,","+# `<` and `>`. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AqBFtCY1sNG8Qj8ng87R3s","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"82c5b41f-ae04-40b4-a1b7-cc94cbdc7cb9","uuid":"d654b52d-9c40-405a-9b55-6802aaa3cf05","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:03:26.858Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py","oldString":"    \"\"\"Render a link whose href is percent-encoded and HTML-escaped, and whose label is escaped text.\"\"\"","newString":"    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"","originalFile":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a backslash inside\n    it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not\n    open an autolink. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link whose href is percent-encoded and HTML-escaped, and whose label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":67,"oldLines":5,"newStart":67,"newLines":5,"lines":[" "," "," def _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:","-    \"\"\"Render a link whose href is percent-encoded and HTML-escaped, and whose label is escaped text.\"\"\"","+    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"","     return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01AqBFtCY1sNG8Qj8ng87R3s","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1d7Gxe2cD3PD6chmgPn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VWoLz2itahirPY7rRHr5hz","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/tests/test_autolinks.py","content":"\"\"\"Autolink tests: URI and email autolinks, the rejected forms, backslash handling, and href\nencoding, plus the executable's output for a whole document.\n\nEach test compares a returned string or the executable's stdout bytes with its exact expected\nvalue. No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-uri-roundtrip: a URI autolink renders as one link with the URI as href and text.\"\"\"\n    uri = \"http://example.org/path\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + uri + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_email_mailto(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-email-mailto: an email autolink renders with a mailto href.\"\"\"\n    address = \"someone@example.org\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + address + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_space_not_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-space-not-autolink: a URI containing a space is literal text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<http://example.org/a b>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;http://example.org/a b&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- URI autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<http://example.org>\", '<a href=\"http://example.org\">http://example.org</a>'),\n        (\"<ab:x>\", '<a href=\"ab:x\">ab:x</a>'),\n        (\"<a+b+c:d>\", '<a href=\"a+b+c:d\">a+b+c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<a.b-c:d>\", '<a href=\"a.b-c:d\">a.b-c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ>\", '<a href=\"MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ\">MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ</a>'),\n        (\"<localhost:5001/foo>\", '<a href=\"localhost:5001/foo\">localhost:5001/foo</a>'),\n        (\"<https://../>\", '<a href=\"https://../\">https://../</a>'),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_uri_autolink_renders_the_uri_as_href_and_label(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_32_characters_is_an_autolink() -> None:\n    scheme = \"a\" + \"b\" * 31\n    uri = scheme + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f'<a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a>'\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_33_characters_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    uri = \"a\" * 33 + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f\"&lt;{uri}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_one_letter_scheme_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<m:abc>\") == \"&lt;m:abc&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_scheme_starting_with_a_digit_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<1ab:x>\") == \"&lt;1ab:x&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_uri_query_ampersands_are_escaped_in_href_and_label() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<https://e.com/?a=1&b=2>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2\">https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_non_ascii_characters_are_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/é>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%C3%A9\">http://e.com/é</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_backtick_is_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/`x>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%60x\">http://e.com/`x</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_with_an_existing_percent_escape_keeps_it() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a%20b>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/a%20b\">http://e.com/a%20b</a>'\n    )\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"control\", [\"\\x01\", \"\\x09\", \"\\x7f\"])\ndef test_uri_containing_an_ascii_control_character_is_literal_text(control: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a\" + control + \"b>\") == (\n        \"&lt;http://e.com/a\" +  f'<a href=\"{expected_href}\">{expected_label}</a>'\n    )","originalFile":"\"\"\"Autolink tests: URI and email autolinks, the rejected forms, backslash handling, and href\nencoding, plus the executable's output for a whole document.\n\nEach test compares a returned string or the executable's stdout bytes with its exact expected\nvalue. No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-uri-roundtrip: a URI autolink renders as one link with the URI as href and text.\"\"\"\n    uri = \"http://example.org/path\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + uri + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_email_mailto(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-email-mailto: an email autolink renders with a mailto href.\"\"\"\n    address = \"someone@example.org\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + address + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_space_not_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-space-not-autolink: a URI containing a space is literal text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<http://example.org/a b>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;http://example.org/a b&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- URI autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<http://example.org>\", '<a href=\"http://example.org\">http://example.org</a>'),\n        (\"<ab:x>\", '<a href=\"ab:x\">ab:x</a>'),\n        (\"<a+b+c:d>\", '<a href=\"a+b+c:d\">a+b+c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<a.b-c:d>\", '<a href=\"a.b-c:d\">a.b-c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ>\", '<a href=\"MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ\">MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ</a>'),\n        (\"<localhost:5001/foo>\", '<a href=\"localhost:5001/foo\">localhost:5001/foo</a>'),\n        (\"<https://../>\", '<a href=\"https://../\">https://../</a>'),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_uri_autolink_renders_the_uri_as_href_and_label(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_32_characters_is_an_autolink() -> None:\n    scheme = \"a\" + \"b\" * 31\n    uri = scheme + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f'<a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a>'\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_33_characters_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    uri = \"a\" * 33 + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f\"&lt;{uri}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_one_letter_scheme_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<m:abc>\") == \"&lt;m:abc&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_scheme_starting_with_a_digit_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<1ab:x>\") == \"&lt;1ab:x&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_uri_query_ampersands_are_escaped_in_href_and_label() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<https://e.com/?a=1&b=2>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2\">https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_non_ascii_characters_are_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/é>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%C3%A9\">http://e.com/é</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_backtick_is_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/`x>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%60x\">http://e.com/`x</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_with_an_existing_percent_escape_keeps_it() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a%20b>\") == (\n        '<a cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-uri-roundtrip: a URI autolink renders as one link with the URI as href and text.\"\"\"\n    uri = \"http://example.org/path\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + uri + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_email_mailto(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-email-mailto: an email autolink renders with a mailto href.\"\"\"\n    address = \"someone@example.org\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + address + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_space_not_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-space-not-autolink: a URI containing a space is literal text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<http://example.org/a b>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;http://example.org/a b&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- URI autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<http://example.org>\", '<a href=\"http://example.org\">http://example.org</a>'),\n        (\"<ab:x>\", '<a href=\"ab:x\">ab:x</a>'),\n        (\"<a+b+c:d>\", '<a href=\"a+b+c:d\">a+b+c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<a.b-c:d>\", '<a href=\"a.b-c:d\">a.b-c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ>\", '<a href=\"MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ\">MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ</a>'),\n        (\"<localhost:5001/foo>\", '<a href=\"localhost:5001/foo\">localhost:5001/foo</a>'),\n        (\"<https://../>\", '<a href=\"https://../\">https://../</a>'),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_uri_autolink_renders_the_uri_as_href_and_label(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_32_characters_is_an_autolink() -> None:\n    scheme = \"a\" + \"b\" * 31\n    uri = scheme + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f'<a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a>'\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_33_characters_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    uri = \"a\" * 33 + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f\"&lt;{uri}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_one_letter_scheme_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<m:abc>\") == \"&lt;m:abc&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_scheme_starting_with_a_digit_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<1ab:x>\") == \"&lt;1ab:x&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_uri_query_ampersands_are_escaped_in_href_and_label() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<https://e.com/?a=1&b=2>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2\">https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-uri-roundtrip: a URI autolink is one link with the URI as href and text.\"\"\"\n    uri = \"http://example.org/path\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + uri + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_email_mailto(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-email-mailto: an email autolink renders with a mailto href.\"\"\"\n    address = \"someone@example.org\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + address + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_space_not_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-space-not-autolink: a URI containing a space is literal text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<http://example.org/a b>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;http://example.org/a b&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- URI autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<http://example.org>\", '<a href=\"http://example.org\">http://example.org</a>'),\n        (\"<ab:x>\", '<a href=\"ab:x\">ab:x</a>'),\n        (\"<a+b+c:d>\", '<a href=\"a+b+c:d\">a+b+c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<a.b-c:d>\", '<a href=\"a.b-c:d\">a.b-c:d</a>'),\n        (\"<MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ>\", '<a href=\"MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ\">MAILTO:FOO@BAR.BAZ</a>'),\n        (\"<localhost:5001/foo>\", '<a href=\"localhost:5001/foo\">localhost:5001/foo</a>'),\n        (\"<https://../>\", '<a href=\"https://../\">https://../</a>'),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_uri_autolink_renders_the_uri_as_href_and_label(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_32_characters_is_an_autolink() -> None:\n    scheme = \"a\" + \"b\" * 31\n    uri = scheme + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f'<a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a>'\n\n\ndef test_uri_scheme_of_33_characters_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    uri = \"a\" * 33 + \":x\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + uri + \">\") == f\"&lt;{uri}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_one_letter_scheme_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<m:abc>\") == \"&lt;m:abc&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_scheme_starting_with_a_digit_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<1ab:x>\") == \"&lt;1ab:x&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_uri_query_ampersands_are_escaped_in_href_and_label() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<https://e.com/?a=1&b=2>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2\">https://e.com/?a=1&amp;b=2</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_non_ascii_characters_are_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/é>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%C3%A9\">http://e.com/é</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_backtick_is_percent_encoded_in_href_only() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/`x>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/%60x\">http://e.com/`x</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_uri_with_an_existing_percent_escape_keeps_it() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a%20b>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/a%20b\">http://e.com/a%20b</a>'\n    )\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"control\", [\"\\x01\", \"\\x09\", \"\\x7f\"])\ndef test_uri_containing_an_ascii_control_character_is_literal_text(control: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a\" + control + \"b>\") == (\n        \"&lt;http://e.com/a\" + control + \"b&gt;\"\n    )\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"body\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"http://e.com/a b\", \"&lt;http://e.com/a b&gt;\"),\n        (\"http://e.com/<a\", \"&lt;http://e.com/&lt;a&gt;\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_uri_body_with_space_or_open_angle_bracket_is_not_an_autolink(\n    body: str, expected: str\n) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + body + \">\") == expected\n\n\ndef test_uri_body_ending_before_a_close_angle_bracket_is_an_autolink_then_text() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://e.com/a>b\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://e.com/a\">http://e.com/a</a>b'\n    )\n\n\n# --- Email autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"address\", \"expected_href\", \"expected_label\"),\n    [\n        (\"foo@bar.example.com\", \"mailto:foo@bar.example.com\", \"foo@bar.example.com\"),\n        (\n            \"foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com\",\n            \"mailto:foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com\",\n            \"foo+special@Bar.baz-bar0.com\",\n        ),\n        (\"a@b\", \"mailto:a@b\", \"a@b\"),\n        (\n            \"a.b!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-@x.y\",\n            \"mailto:a.b!#$%25&amp;'*+/=?%5E_%60%7B%7C%7D~-@x.y\",\n            \"a.b!#$%&amp;'*+/=?^_`{|}~-@x.y\",\n        ),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_email_autolink_renders_mailto_href_and_address_label(\n    address: str, expected_href: str, expected_label: str\n) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + address + \">\") == (\n        f'<a href=\"{expected_href}\">{expected_label}</a>'\n    )\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"address\",\n    [\n        \"foo@-bar.com\",\n        \"foo@bar-.com\",\n        \"foo@bar..com\",\n        \"@bar.com\",\n        \"foo@\",\n        \"foo bar@x.com\",\n        \"foo@bär.com\",\n    ],\n)\ndef test_malformed_email_is_literal_text(address: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + address + \">\") == f\"&lt;{address}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_email_label_longer_than_63_characters_in_a_label_is_literal_text() -> None:\n    label = \"a\" * 64\n    address = \"x@\" + label + \".com\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + address + \">\") == f\"&lt;{address}&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_email_label_of_63_characters_is_an_autolink() -> None:\n    label = \"a\" * 63\n    address = \"x@\" + label + \".com\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<\" + address + \">\") == (\n        f'<a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a>'\n    )\n\n\n# --- Rejected forms and backslash handling ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<>\", \"&lt;&gt;\"),\n        (\"< https://foo.bar >\", \"&lt; https://foo.bar &gt;\"),\n        (\"<foo.bar.baz>\", \"&lt;foo.bar.baz&gt;\"),\n        (\"https://example.com\", \"https://example.com\"),\n        (\"foo@bar.example.com\", \"foo@bar.example.com\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_text_that_is_not_an_autolink_stays_literal(source: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(source) == expected\n\n\ndef test_backslash_is_inert_inside_a_uri_autolink() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<https://example.com/\\\\[\\\\>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"https://example.com/%5C%5B%5C\">https://example.com/\\\\[\\\\</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_backslash_in_a_rejected_email_body_is_an_escape_of_the_next_character() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<foo\\\\+@bar.example.com>\") == \"&lt;foo+@bar.example.com&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_backslash_before_less_than_prevents_an_autolink() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\<http://e.com>\") == \"&lt;http://e.com&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_backslash_before_ordinary_character_is_kept() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"a\\\\b\") == \"a\\\\b\"\n\n\n# --- Left-to-right scanning ---\n\n\ndef test_two_autolinks_in_one_line_both_render() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://a.b> and <c@d.ef>\") == (\n        '<a href=\"http://a.b\">http://a.b</a> and <a href=\"mailto:c@d.ef\">c@d.ef</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_a_less_than_sign_that_cannot_open_an_autolink_does_not_hide_a_later_one() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a:b<http://x.y>\") == (\n        '&lt;a:b<a href=\"http://x.y\">http://x.y</a>'\n    )\n\n\ndef test_empty_content_renders_nothing() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\") == No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Autolinks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_uri_roundtrip(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-uri-roundtrip: a URI autolink is one link with the URI as href and text.\"\"\"\n    uri = \"http://example.org/path\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + uri + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"{uri}\">{uri}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_email_mailto(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-email-mailto: an email autolink renders with a mailto href.\"\"\"\n    address = \"someone@example.org\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<\" + address + \">\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f'<p><a href=\"mailto:{address}\">{address}</a></p>\\n'\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_space_not_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-space-not-autolink: a URI containing a space is literal text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<http://example.org/a b>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;http://example.org/a b&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_autolinks_corpus_section_passes_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC autolinks-corpus-section: the scoped Autolinks conformance section exits 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Autolinks$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\n# --- URI autolinks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"source\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"<http://example.org>\", '<a href=\"http://example.org\">http://example.org</a>'),\n        (\"<ab:x>\", '<a {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1dCJ8DyGr17AQEQDXhQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"RESULT: SUCCESS\n\nFILES CHANGED:\n- mdparser/inlines.py\n- tests/test_autolinks.py\n\nSUMMARY:\n- `parse_inline` now scans left to right. At a `<` it tries a URI autolink (scheme of 2 to 32 characters, then a colon, then a body with no control characters, space, `<` or `>`), then an email autolink (the spec's HTML5 regex, with `mailto:` prepended). Matches become `<a href>` with the href percent-encoded and then HTML-escaped, and the label HTML-escaped. Anything else stays escaped text.\n- Backslash escapes are inert inside an autolink because the whole autolink is consumed first. Outside autolinks, a backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that character, so `\\<` does not open an autolink.\n- Gate: `python3 sources/spec_tests.py --program ./commonmark --spec sources/spec.txt --pattern '^Autolinks$'` gives 19 passed, 0 failed, 0 errored, exit 0.\n- Tests: `tests/test_autolinks.py` has the three declared acceptance checks as tests, plus the scoped corpus gate run as a subprocess. Finer tests cover scheme length boundaries (2, 32, 33 characters), email label length (63 and 64), malformed emails, percent-encoding of non-ASCII, backtick and existing `%XX`, control characters, `&` escaping, and left-to-right scanning. Each test compares a return value or stdout bytes exactly.\n- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` gives 182 passed. Only `mdparser/inlines.py` changed and the new test file was added; nothing under `sources/` was touched.\n- I did not run `sources/full_test.sh`, because this step declares only the scoped gate.\n\nBLOCKERS:\n- None.\n\n<blueprint-decisions>\n[{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-Autolinks.md\",\"severity\":\"Low\",\"subject\":\"Minimal backslash-escape handling in the inline scanner\",\"decision\":\"The Autolinks section's example `<foo\\\\+@bar.example.com>` expects the backslash in front of `+` to be removed outside the autolink, and the gate requires that example to pass. I therefore added a minimal rule to the inline scanner: a backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that character. A full backslash-escape story would replace this, and autolink behaviour does not depend on it.
